$comment: Test files that CI intentionally does not run. tests/test-coverage-registration.test.cjs fails on any test file CI does not reach unless it is listed here, and on entries that are stale (the file is gone or CI now runs it). A path ending in /** covers every test file under that directory. Every entry needs a reason.

entries.reason: Executes documentation snippets against the live hosted test agent (test-agent.adcontextprotocol.org), so it depends on the network and on that deployment, and it currently fails. Run it on demand with `npm run test:snippets` or `node tests/snippet-validation.test.cjs --file <doc>`.
Simulation scenarios need a real Postgres (DATABASE_URL) and a single forked worker. Run them on demand with `npm run test:simulation`.
Playwright smoke scripts that drive a running app through dev login (TARGET_URL). Run them manually with `node tests/e2e/<name>.smoke.js` against a local server.
